key_proofs.quote: Op woensdag is onze winkel dicht. Vanaf donderdag zijn we weer open, van 9.00 tot 18.00 uur.

meaning.contrivance_check: Every paragraph answers a pick-up question (when, what to show, how to pay, who may collect); the staff-brings-it-outside detail is a normal shop service and no question depends on a forced fact.

meaning.situation_summary: A courier failed to deliver a parcel on Tuesday; it now waits in a shop next to the supermarket from Wednesday 13 May (12.00-19.00) until Monday 18 May with a code and ID, after which it goes back to the web shop.
